update.title: Built Work Report System to preserve completed work
update.summary: Created a command-line reporting tool that records what changed, why it changed, project context, commit statistics, and file or image references as searchable PostgreSQL records.

blocks.body:
## Capture the work while it is still fresh

Work Report turns a completed task into a structured record while its reasoning and evidence are still available. Each report keeps the project, title, summary, description, rationale, status, tags, technologies, and references to relevant files or images together instead of leaving that context scattered across terminal history and memory.

Creating a report also records the current commit and derives its file and line statistics automatically.

blocks.caption: Each report combines human context with repository facts, then makes the result available through recent, search, and detail commands.
blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Work[Completed work] --> Create[Create report]
  Context[Description and reasoning] --> Create
  Evidence[File and image references] --> Create
  Git[Commit and diff stats] --> Create
  Create --> History[(PostgreSQL history)]
  History --> Recent[Recent reports]
  History --> Search[Search by project or tag]
  History --> Detail[Full report]
blocks.summary: Each report combines human context with repository facts, then makes the result available through recent, search, and detail commands.

blocks.body:
## Search structured work history

The command-line interface lists recent work, searches by project or validated tag, and expands one report into its full description, reasoning, evidence references, and Git statistics. A controlled vocabulary gives tags consistent names, making reports easier to find and reuse.

blocks.alt: Terminal showing a structured Work Report with project details, description, reasoning, evidence references, tags, technologies, and Git statistics.
blocks.caption: A report detail view brings narrative, evidence references, tags, technologies, and Git statistics into one readable record.

blocks.body:
## Keep the source record separate from presentation

A Work Report is the factual technical record of a task. It can preserve implementation detail and local evidence while portfolio presentation remains a separate editorial layer, keeping the source material useful without treating an internal report as finished public copy.

update.previewAlt: Built Work Report System to preserve completed work

parts.title: Reorganized Work Report around a package boundary
parts.summary: Moved Work Report’s command, agent flow, evidence handlers, artifact mapping, and database migrations into one installable Python package with explicit artifact review and provenance handling.

parts.title: Turned Work Report creation into a guided wizard
parts.summary: Work Report now guides creation through required facts, evidence review, handler-defined verification prompts, and final confirmation before saving the report and its selected evidence.

parts.title: Made Work Report Git tracking package-aware
parts.summary: Work Report now uses the report’s project identity as the repository context for commit metadata, diff statistics, and captured Git evidence, routing VCSH-backed packages through their independent histories.

parts.title: Built an evidence pipeline from Work Reports to portfolio pages
parts.summary: Preserved screenshots, code, terminal output, comparisons, and data as typed Work Report artifacts, then mapped them into editable blocks for portfolio pages.

related.title: Built a shared history database for system activity
related.summary: Built a PostgreSQL history store for tool operations and artifacts, with a normalized SQLAlchemy schema, repository API, and provenance queries.

related.title: Reworked Portfolio Editor architecture and editing flows
related.summary: Centralized Portfolio Editor state and actions, then connected report browsing, project import, block editing, live preview, and undo and redo into one reliable workspace.

related.title: Made Work Report artifacts durable at capture time
related.summary: Copied attached files and reconstructed text artifacts into report-owned storage at capture time, so each Work Report retained the material it referenced.

related.title: Built Portfolio Editor to connect Work Reports to portfolio pages
related.summary: Portfolio Editor now combines Work Report material, structured project fields, seven composable block types, and the Portfolio Site renderer in one split-pane authoring workflow.
